TEST B / independent preexisting orphan: separate tmp_path archive, create .jsonl.lock before acquisition, do NOT patch os.write; assert ArchiveWriterLock(...,timeout=0.05,poll_interval=0.005) raises TimeoutError and the existing lock remains unchanged. Only remove test fixture lock in finally after no live owner.

Test cases must never combine a preexisting orphan lock with a PID-write ENOSPC expectation. Use no network and no blind sleeps; preserve fail-closed crash-orphan behavior.
